claim.summary: src/click/shell_completion.py implements Click's tab completion. shell_complete() parses the `<shell>_<instruction>` value of the env var. It looks up a ShellComplete subclass in the `_available_shells` registry and either prints the shell script (`source`) or prints completions (`complete`). Command._main_shell_completion (core.py:1619-1649) calls it and then calls sys.exit with its return value. ShellComplete.get_completions resolves a Context chain (`_resolve_context`), picks the object that should complete (`_resolve_incomplete`), and calls that object's `.shell_complete(ctx, incomplete)`. That returns a list of CompletionItem. Each shell subclass reads COMP_WORDS and COMP_CWORD from os.environ and formats items in its own wire format. Bash, Zsh, Fish and PowerShell are built in. Other shells can be added with add_completion_class.

interfaces.name: shell_complete
interfaces.behavior: Does `shell, _, instruction = instruction.partition('_')`, then looks up the class with get_completion_class(shell). It builds `comp_cls(cli, ctx_args, prog_name, complete_var)`. For 'source' it writes `comp.source().encode()` with echo(nl=False) and returns 0. For 'complete' it writes `comp.complete().encode()` with echo (newline appended) and returns 0. Output is written as bytes so Windows does not turn LF into CRLF.
edge_cases: Unknown shell returns 1
Unknown instruction returns 1
A value with no underscore gives shell=whole string and instruction='', so it returns 1 unless the shell name is unregistered, which also returns 1

interfaces.name: CompletionItem
interfaces.behavior: Generic class with __slots__ ('value','type','help','_info'). `type` defaults to 'plain'. Click uses 'dir' and 'file' for special shell handling. `help` defaults to None. Extra kwargs go into `_info`.
edge_cases: __getattr__ returns None for any unknown attribute instead of raising AttributeError (`_info.get(name)`)
Extra kwargs are not used by built-in shells

interfaces.name: CompletionItem.__init__
interfaces.behavior: Sets value, type, help and `_info=kwargs`.
edge_cases: Arbitrary kwargs accepted

interfaces.name: CompletionItem.__getattr__
interfaces.behavior: Returns `self._info.get(name)`. It is only called when normal attribute lookup fails.
edge_cases: Missing keys give None

interfaces.name: ShellComplete
interfaces.behavior: Base class. Takes cli, ctx_args, prog_name and complete_var. Subclasses set the class attributes `name` and `source_template`, and implement get_completion_args and format_completion. complete() runs get_completion_args, then get_completions, then format_completion per item, and joins with '\n'.
edge_cases: The base class has no `name` or `source_template` defaults, so using it directly for source() fails
The tests use the base class directly for get_completions

interfaces.name: ShellComplete.func_name
interfaces.behavior: Property. Replaces '-' with '_' in prog_name, strips non-word ASCII characters, and returns `_{safe}_completion`.
edge_cases: Dots and other punctuation are removed (not turned into underscores)

interfaces.name: ShellComplete.source_vars
interfaces.behavior: Returns a dict with complete_func, complete_var and prog_name for formatting the template.
edge_cases: Subclasses can override this to add template variables

interfaces.name: ShellComplete.source
interfaces.behavior: Returns `self.source_template % self.source_vars()`, a %-style format.
edge_cases: Literal % in a custom template must be escaped as %%

interfaces.name: ShellComplete.get_completion_args
interfaces.behavior: Abstract. Returns (args, incomplete).

interfaces.name: ShellComplete.get_completions
interfaces.behavior: Calls `_resolve_context(cli, ctx_args, prog_name, args)`, then `_resolve_incomplete(ctx, args, incomplete)`. Then returns `obj.shell_complete(ctx, incomplete)`.
edge_cases: incomplete may be ''
`args` can be mutated, because an `--opt=val` incomplete appends the option name to it
ctx_args gets resilient_parsing=True set on it (mutated)

interfaces.name: ShellComplete.format_completion
interfaces.behavior: Abstract. Turns a CompletionItem into a string for the shell script.

interfaces.name: ShellComplete.complete
interfaces.behavior: Returns the newline-joined formatted completions.
edge_cases: No completions gives an empty string

interfaces.name: BashComplete
interfaces.behavior: name='bash'. get_completion_args splits COMP_WORDS with split_arg_string and reads int(COMP_CWORD). args = cwords[1:cword]; incomplete = cwords[cword], or '' on IndexError. format_completion returns `type,value` and ignores help. source() first runs _check_version.
edge_cases: Missing env vars raise KeyError
A non-integer COMP_CWORD raises ValueError
Help text is dropped

interfaces.name: BashComplete._check_version
interfaces.behavior: Static method. Runs `bash --norc -c 'echo ${BASH_VERSION}'` with subprocess. It echoes a message to stderr if bash is older than 4.4 or the version cannot be detected. It does not raise or abort.
edge_cases: No bash on PATH prints the 'Couldn't detect Bash version' message
Tests patch it out with monkeypatch

interfaces.name: ZshComplete
interfaces.behavior: name='zsh'. Same args logic as Bash. format_completion returns `type\nvalue\nhelp` with help defaulting to '_'. Colons in value are escaped as `\:` only when help is not '_'.
edge_cases: Colon escaping applies only to items that have help text
The script is deliberately frozen for backward compatibility

interfaces.name: FishComplete
interfaces.behavior: name='fish'. COMP_CWORD holds the partial word itself, not an index. args = cwords[1:]. If incomplete is non-empty it is passed through split_arg_string(...)[0], and the same word is popped from args if it is the last one. format_completion returns `type,value` and appends `\t<help>` when help is set. In help, newlines are escaped as `\n` and tabs become spaces (8.4.2).
edge_cases: An empty COMP_CWORD gives incomplete=''
A quoted partial word is unquoted by the split

interfaces.name: PowerShellComplete
interfaces.behavior:
name='powershell' (added in 8.5.0). Same args logic as Bash, using an index COMP_CWORD. format_completion returns `type
value
help`, with help defaulting to '_'.  and 
 in help become spaces.
edge_cases: The PowerShell script consumes 3 lines per item

interfaces.name: add_completion_class
interfaces.behavior: Sets `_available_shells[name or cls.name] = cls` and returns cls, so it works as a decorator (no-argument form only).
edge_cases: Overwrites an existing registration silently
Raises AttributeError if name is None and cls has no `name`

interfaces.name: get_completion_class
interfaces.behavior: Returns `_available_shells.get(shell)`, or None if the shell is not registered. Typing overloads exist for bash, fish and zsh. There is no overload for powershell, which falls to the `str` overload.
edge_cases: Unknown shell returns None

interfaces.name: split_arg_string
interfaces.behavior: Uses shlex.shlex(posix=True) with whitespace_split=True and commenters=''. If shlex raises ValueError (unclosed quote or trailing backslash), it appends the partial token `lex.token` to the output.
edge_cases: 'example \'my file' gives ['example','my file']
'example my\\' gives ['example','my']
Empty string gives []
'#' is not treated as a comment

interfaces.name: _resolve_context
interfaces.behavior: Sets ctx_args['resilient_parsing']=True and calls cli.make_context(prog_name, args.copy(), **ctx_args). For Groups it follows subcommands with resolve_command and make_context(resilient_parsing=True). Chained groups use allow_extra_args and allow_interspersed_args=False. It returns the deepest context. It stops early if resolve_command returns None for the command.
edge_cases: Callbacks and prompts are not run (resilient parsing)
Unknown subcommand returns the current ctx

interfaces.name: _resolve_incomplete
interfaces.behavior: Normalizes '=': `incomplete=='='` becomes ''. `--opt=val` is split, and the name is appended to args. If '--' is not in args and incomplete starts with an option prefix, it returns (ctx.command, incomplete). Otherwise it returns the first Option for which _is_incomplete_option is true. Next it returns the first Argument that is still incomplete. Finally it falls back to (ctx.command, incomplete), which gives subcommand names.
edge_cases: After '--', option-like words are values
Flags and counts never need values

interfaces.name: _is_incomplete_argument
interfaces.behavior: True for an Argument that has nargs=-1, or was not given on the command line, or has nargs>1 with fewer values than nargs.
edge_cases: Non-Argument params return False

interfaces.name: _is_incomplete_option
interfaces.behavior: True if param is an Option that is not a flag or count, and the last option-looking arg within nargs positions from the end is in param.opts.
edge_cases: Flags and counts return False

claim.error_conventions: The module raises no exceptions deliberately. shell_complete signals failure through return codes: 1 for an unknown shell or instruction, 0 for success. Command._main_shell_completion then calls sys.exit(rv). Abstract methods raise bare NotImplementedError (lines 351 and 373). Missing COMP_WORDS or COMP_CWORD env vars surface as KeyError from os.environ. split_arg_string catches the shlex ValueError internally. BashComplete._check_version reports problems through echo(..., err=True) using gettext `_()` messages. The messages are plain sentences ending in a period, for example "Shell completion is not supported for Bash versions older than 4.4.".

examples.description: Full end-to-end complete via env var
examples.code:
cli = Group("cli", commands=[Command("a"), Command("b", help="bee")])
env["_CLI_COMPLETE"] = f"{shell}_complete"
result = runner.invoke(cli, env=env)
assert result.output == expect

class MyshComplete(ShellComplete):
    name = "mysh"
    source_template = "dummy source"
assert add_completion_class(MyshComplete) is MyshComplete

c = CompletionItem("test", a=1)
assert c.a == 1
assert c.b is None

tests.how_it_asserts: Plain pytest functions with bare asserts. A helper `_get_words` builds a ShellComplete directly and compares the lists of values. Full-flow tests use the `runner` fixture with `env={'_CLI_COMPLETE': '<shell>_complete'}` and compare result.output strings. They are parametrized over bash, zsh, fish and powershell. The `_patch_for_completion` fixture monkeypatches BashComplete._check_version. The `_restore_available_shells` fixture snapshots and restores `_available_shells` for the add_completion_class tests. There are also tests for zsh colon escaping, LF line endings, closed files, and the fish and powershell help escaping.

extension_points.name: add_completion_class / _available_shells
extension_points.what_could_attach: Register a new ShellComplete subclass for another shell (for example nushell or elvish) by setting name, source_template, get_completion_args and format_completion.

extension_points.name: ShellComplete.source_vars / source_template
extension_points.what_could_attach: Add template variables or replace the script in a subclass.

extension_points.name: ShellComplete.get_completions
extension_points.what_could_attach: Filter, sort or post-process the CompletionItems before they are formatted.

extension_points.name: ShellComplete.format_completion
extension_points.what_could_attach: Emit custom wire formats, including use of CompletionItem kwargs metadata.

extension_points.name: CompletionItem kwargs (_info)
extension_points.what_could_attach: Carry custom metadata such as a group or a suffix to custom shell classes.

extension_points.name: Parameter shell_complete callback
extension_points.what_could_attach: Per-parameter custom completion functions, which produce the CompletionItem lists.

extension_points.name: Command._main_shell_completion
extension_points.what_could_attach: Override to change the complete_var or hook completion.

gaps.description: No way to unregister a shell or list the registered shells publicly. Callers must touch the private `_available_shells`.
gaps.why_plausible: The registry already has add and get functions; remove and list are small additions.

gaps.description: Bash ignores help text, and Bash has no description support.
gaps.why_plausible: Other shells show the help, and it could be added through the script template.

gaps.description: The four get_completion_args implementations are duplicated, and bash, zsh and powershell are identical.
gaps.why_plausible: A shared helper or intermediate base class would remove the copies.

gaps.description: No dedicated error handling or diagnostics for a malformed instruction (it just returns 1 silently), and missing env vars raise KeyError.

gaps.why_plausible: A typing oversight with a one-line fix.

limitations: Completion runs make_context with resilient_parsing=True, so side effects in callbacks are skipped, but any custom shell_complete code still runs on every Tab press.
Bash support is documented as requiring bash >= 4.4. The check only prints a warning when the script is sourced.
The Zsh script is frozen for backward compatibility, which limits changes to its wire format.
The wire formats are not escaped for commas or newlines in values. Bash and Fish split on ',', and the Zsh and PowerShell formats rely on newlines.
`_check_version` compares the version strings lexicographically (`major < '4'`), which is wrong for 2-digit major versions such as 10.
ShellComplete.source with `%` formatting breaks on a stray `%` in a template.
